hints.title: What does an in-order walk produce?
hints.body: An in-order traversal of a valid binary search tree visits values in strictly increasing order. What would a violation look like during that walk?

hints.title: Bounds, not just parents
hints.body: Every node is constrained by all of its ancestors. Pass down an allowed open interval `(low, high)` and check that the current value lies strictly inside it.

hints.title: Narrow the interval
hints.body: Going left narrows the upper bound to the current value; going right narrows the lower bound. A value equal to either bound is invalid. An empty subtree is valid.
